_comment: Motivational scripts with a specific, slightly uncomfortable angle. Avoids generic consistency-is-key filler.

scripts.text: I trained for two years and looked identical. Same weights. Same body. Same excuses. Then I started writing it down. Turns out I'd been lifting the same numbers since March. The data was humiliating. It was also the fix. Track every rep. MuscleMap, free in your browser.

Nobody at the gym is looking at you. They're looking at themselves. That's the good news. Every rep you skip, you skipped for nobody. Every one you push, you keep. The scoreboard is private. MuscleMap keeps it honest. Track every rep. MuscleMap, free in your browser.

Motivation is a mood. Moods end. What survives is the log. Open the app. See last week's number. Beat it by five pounds. That's the entire system. You don't need to feel like it. MuscleMap remembers when you don't. Track every rep. MuscleMap, free in your browser.

A year from now you'll be a year older either way. The only question is whether there's a log behind you. Three sessions a week is a hundred and fifty sessions. That changes a body. Start the record today. Track every rep. MuscleMap, free in your browser.

Week one is exciting. Week twelve is boring. Boring is where everyone quits. Boring is also where it works. You won't see it in the mirror. You'll see it in the numbers. That's what the chart is for. Track every rep. MuscleMap, free in your browser.
